name: Tencent CloudBase
line: Hosted backend with PostgreSQL, auth, file storage, functions, APIs, and realtime.

free.text: China dev/test: 3,000 pts/mo; renew every 6mo; published mini-app deleted day 15

cells.metered: $20/mo Pro list; $15 limited-time offer with 200k credits
cells.regions: International: Singapore; China: Shanghai and Singapore

sql.math: At 30 active hours, PG usage is $1.046. At 730 hours, it is $22.046. The Pro plan is $20 at list price, or $15 on promotion. Egress and logs are not priced.
With no active PG slots, 1 GB of storage is $0.146. Unused Pro credits leave the $20 list price or the $15 promotional subscription.

files.math: Known file usage is $18.42001. If API requests also count, it is $20.07001. The Pro plan is $20 at list price, or $15 on promotion. Metadata and other meters are not yet priced.

jobs.math: 10K functions cost $0.0855 for runtime and calls, or $0.105 with API or gateway calls. Pro credits cover this, but whether everything fits is unknown.
